items.title: Understanding Temperature
items.explanation: Temperature is a measure of hotness or coldness in the body or surroundings. It cannot always be judged by touch alone, as different people may feel different temperatures for the same water due to individual sensitivity. Accurate measurement requires specific tools designed for this purpose.

items.title: Measuring Body Temperature
items.explanation: A clinical thermometer is used to measure body temperature. It consists of a long glass tube with a fine capillary that expands when heated, allowing the user to read the temperature at the highest point reached by the liquid.

items.title: Precautions for Accurate Measurement
items.explanation: To ensure accurate readings, the tip of the thermometer must be kept in contact with the skin until it reads a stable value. The user should not move the thermometer around during reading to avoid getting a lower temperature reading.
